LEVEL 2 — apartment · 480 sf gross / 437 sf net
north ↑ · property line 5' — keep this wall (nearly) window-free
south stair zone · 5' clear to selected 18' x 6' replacement shed
east · yard & main house · morning sun
• PRO: direct alley access; straight south stair arrives at a covered SE balcony without consuming apartment or garage area.
• PRO: fridge + tall kitchen cabinets sit on the east gable end near the E-W ridge, not beneath a north/south roof slope.
• ROOF CHECK: headroom bands are diagrammatic; final section must verify floor elevation, joist depth, insulation, and 7' ceiling compliance.
• SITE RESPONSE: selected 18' x 6' replacement shed sits on the south 5' setback, leaving 5' clear before the stair; verify fire + maintenance details.
